summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education, citing specific examples of how E-Rate supports various operational and instructional functions in their schools. They urge the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and to work with schools to modernize and improve the program. The comments urge preservation of E-Rate funding and infrastructure support, emphasizing its role in providing connectivity for schools and libraries. The comments express opposition to any sunset or reduction of E-Rate funding and infrastructure support.
